subject: Advocate coordination for InsightCare — EU healthcare reference calls
messages:
From: Nadia Vogel <nadia@insightcare.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01 09:12 +01:00
Subject: Request: peer references for late-stage eval (EU, healthcare)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — InsightCare is very interested but procurement has asked for customer reference calls focused on two things:

- EU-based healthcare customers who use Redwood in production for PHI/PII workloads
- References who can speak to deployment model (VPC/private), latency SLAs, and SOC2/BAA controls

Could you connect us with 2–3 peers who can do 30-minute calls next week? Prefer EU timezones (CEST) and customers who can talk about integration with our streaming ingestion pipeline.

I attached our RFI to show the level of detail procurement expects. Also looping Tom Hsu (procurement) on scheduling.

Appreciate your help — this is the last set of checks before the procurement approval.

Best,
Nadia Vogel
Head of Platform Evaluation, InsightCare
attachments: InsightCare_RFI.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Vogel <nadia@insightcare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Tom Hsu <thsu@insightcare.com>
Date: 2027-05-01 11:03 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: peer references for late-stage eval (EU, healthcare)

Nadia — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the RFI. We can absolutely put together a targeted advocate slate.

Quick clarifying Qs so we match appropriately:
- Is the primary ask clinical (patient-facing telehealth) or administrative (billing/claims)?
- Are you ok with references speaking at a product + procurement level (i.e., both engineering and procurement contacts)?

Initial plan: I will loop in Monica (SE) to propose 2–3 customers who have the exact deployment profile (VPC + BAA + CEST ops). Laura will coordinate logistics and ensure we have consent and a one-pager for each reference.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm scope above.
2) I’ll propose 2 time slots for each matched reference next week (CEST).
3) Share short prep notes for InsightCare and the reference call agenda (5 minutes each).

We’ll also include SOC2 evidence and our standard BAA template for Tom to review.

On it — will circle back with names and availability by tomorrow EOD.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Reference_Guide_2027.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Nadia Vogel <nadia@insightcare.com>
Date: 2027-05-02 08:46 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: peer references for late-stage eval (EU, healthcare)

Hi all — pulled together potential advocates and short call notes. I filtered for production deployments in healthcare in EU, VPC or dedicated, and familiarity with PHI handling.

Candidate A — CareSync (UK)- Primary contact: Emma Clarke, Head of Platform- Can speak to: VPC deployment, BAA, latency tuning for real-time triage (95p latency SLAs at 512-token windows)- Availability: Tue 10–12 CEST or Wed 14–16 CEST- Ask for the call: focus on integration, ops handoff, and monitoring

Candidate B — MedPilot GmbH (DE)- Primary contact: Jonas K. (CTO)- Can speak to: SOC2 compliance, audit trails, and private deployment model; recently ran a 6-week POC to validate throughput- Availability: Tue 15–17 CEST or Thu 09–11 CEST

Logistics:
- I’ll send short one-pagers for both (what they can speak to, do/don’t disclose) and confirm consent for procurement to join the call.
- For SOC2 evidence: legal can provide a redacted SOC2 summary and we can share our BAA.

Attachments: reference_onepagers.zip (contains CareSync_onepager.pdf, MedPilot_onepager.pdf)

Let me know which slot works for InsightCare and whether procurement wants a separate call or to attend the reference calls.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Nadia Vogel <nadia@insightcare.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <thsu@insightcare.com>, procurement@insightcare.com
Date: 2027-05-02 14:10 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: peer references for late-stage eval (EU, healthcare)

Hi Monica / Aditya — this is perfect, thanks.

We’d like to schedule:
- CareSync: Wed 14:30–15:00 CEST (30m)
- MedPilot: Thu 09:30–10:00 CEST (30m)

Tom (cc) will join one of the calls for procurement-level questions — procurement prefers to join the MedPilot call on Thu if possible. If procurement wants a separate, shorter call for contract-level Qs that’s fine too.

Two small asks before calls:
1) A 1-paragraph intro we can share with the reference so they have context (what InsightCare cares about: streaming ingestion, PHI safeguards, expected QPS).
2) A suggested script/agenda (5–7 bullets) so we keep calls tight.

If you can share those in the next 24 hours, we’ll confirm the slots and publish invites.

Thanks — looking forward to these.

Best,
Nadia

Aditya — quick procurement note:

- We need a signed BAA before production access. Please send your standard BAA and a timeline for legal review.
- SOC2 summary and a redacted report would be helpful; procurement wants evidence of encryption-at-rest, key management, and change-control logs.
- Please provide a vendor PO template and any standard SLA language you commit to for Dedicated/VPC offerings.

I attached a short procurement spec template with the must-haves. If you can route to legal today, that will keep us on track for a May 20 rollout decision.

Thanks,
Tom Hsu
Procurement Manager, InsightCare
